# SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE — Lantern Hollow

This document is a synthetic test fixture. Lantern Hollow, the River
Sarn, and every person named in it are invented for ThoughtForge
tests. Nothing here is drawn from any real dataset, persona, or
reference library.

## The Hollow

Lantern Hollow is a small invented village in a bend of the River
Sarn. Its mill stands on the north bank, and its ferry crosses at
the willow narrows. The village keeps a tide bell that rings twice
at dusk: once for the ferry's last crossing, and once for the
lanterns to be lit along the mill path.

## The Lantern-Keeper

Wrenna the Lantern-Keeper tends the mill-path lanterns. She trims
each wick at dusk, carries spare oil in a brass flask, and records
the river level each morning on the mill door in chalk. When the
River Sarn runs high, Wrenna hangs a red lantern at the ferry post
so travellers know the crossing is closed.

## The Ferry

Tomas the Ferry-Hand poles the ferry between the willow narrows
and the mill landing. The crossing takes eleven minutes in calm
water. No ferry runs after the second tide bell.
